name: Merchant Fantasy
source:
You're the clerk of your local mom-and-pop magic item shop, in the little town of Phandalin, just south Neverwinter... and, well, you're far from being the employee of the month. 

Discover today's clients and try to make some shiny gold before you get fired!

[From [url=https://team-wagashi.itch.io/merchant-fantasy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在无冬城以南的凡达林小镇，你是本地一家夫妻经营的魔法道具店的店员。至于你的工作表现嘛…离本月最佳员工还差得很远。

来看看今天上门的顾客都是谁，趁被开除之前多赚几枚亮闪闪的金币吧！

［摘自[url=https://team-wagashi.itch.io/merchant-fantasy]itch.io[/url]］
